question: What is \((20-(2010-201))\) \(+(2010-(201-20))?\)
solution:
Subtracting a parenthesized difference changes the signs of both terms. Removing the parentheses therefore gives
\[
\begin{aligned}
&(20-2010+201)+(2010-201+20)\\
&=20+20=\boxed{40}.
\end{aligned}
\]
The \(2010\) terms cancel, as do the \(201\) terms. The answer is choice \(\mathrm{C}\).
